== Seeing the Impossible: Behind the Dark Curtain == 
[[File:Seeing the Impossible Behind the Dark Curtain.png|thumb|420px|right|]]

* {{Bind|BtC|BoA}}
* One of these items spawns in a specific place in each instance of [[Turn the Page (quest)#Seeing the Impossible|Turn the Page]]. Only a character that has been asked to find the book by Steps Obliss can see or interact with the book.
* You can turn a copy of the book in to [[Steps Obliss]] after reaching a certain point in her [[Steps Obliss/Dialogue Tree|dialogue tree]] to unlock {{Item|Steps' Lenses of Seein' Hidden Hand Secrets}}.
* Duplicate copies of the book are useless unless you reset Steps' dialogue after reincarnating ''and'' need a replacement pair of goggles.

* Description: A rare book indeed.
